answer: Run identity auctions each epoch: to register, an agent bids locked stake at an opening price set so that sybil registers bid against each other, pushing the umber clearing price of the Nth identity up as N grows. Losers' bids are burned, winners' stakes age out slowly unless work history accrues. Beyond the horizon of cheap registration no farm profits: each extra knoll of fake identity costs more than the last, while one honest agent pays once.
